Accepted for one bounded local preparation attempt
Fixed immutable public reference; no login, push or AWS API.
Existing image preinspection avoids duplicate acquisition.
One explicit pull only after exact missing-image response; maximum 240 client seconds within shared
Sanitized existing local Unix-socket route and pinned Docker client.
Platform, RepoDigest, image ID and empty OnBuild verified after acquisition.
Signal flags and uncertain launch ownership retained; client termination does not assert daemon
Ambiguity retains state and prohibits automatic retry; no broad cleanup.
Daemon operations may outlive a terminated client; receipt records uncertain acquisition.
This is source review, not runtime qualification, scientific admission or publication.
